title: New Year’s Eve at Portsea Hotel
summary: New Year's Eve by the water at the Portsea Hotel, with Kayla Bruno and Holmes John from 5pm, then Piero and singer Karina Chavez headlining from 10pm through the midnight countdown. Strictly 18+.
